description: This file defines the interface for managing HDMI input devices within a specific application or system. It includes class declarations, constants, and function signatures related to HDMI input management, configuration, and status querying.

classes.name: HdmiInput
classes.description: A singleton class that manages HDMI input operations, including port selection, video scaling, and retrieving HDMI status information.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the HdmiInput class.

methods.name: getNumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of HDMI input ports available.

methods.name: isPresented
methods.description: Checks if HDMI input is currently presented.

methods.name: isActivePort
methods.description: Determines if a specific port is active.

methods.name: getActivePort
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active HDMI port.

methods.name: isPortConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specific HDMI port is connected.

methods.name: selectPort
methods.description: Selects a specific HDMI port, with optional audio and video parameters.

methods.name: scaleVideo
methods.description: Sets the video scaling parameters.

methods.name: selectZoomMode
methods.description: Selects the zoom mode for HDMI input.

methods.name: pauseAudio
methods.description: Pauses audio on the HDMI input.

methods.name: resumeAudio
methods.description: Resumes audio on the HDMI input.

methods.name: getCurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current video mode as a string.

methods.name: getCurrentVideoModeObj
methods.description: Retrieves detailed current video mode settings.

methods.name: getEDIDBytesInfo
methods.description: Fetches EDID bytes information for a specified HDMI port.

methods.name: getHDMISPDInfo
methods.description: Gets SPD (Secondary Product Data) information from HDMI.

methods.name: setEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for an HDMI port.

methods.name: getEdidVersion
methods.description: Gets the current EDID version for an HDMI port.

methods.name: getHdmiALLMStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) status for HDMI.

methods.name: getSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Lists supported game-related features.

methods.name: getAVLatency
methods.description: Retrieves audio and video latency values.

methods.name: setEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Enables or disables EDID support for ALLM.

methods.name: getEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Checks if EDID supports ALLM.
